title: Cadence state
description: cadence/state.json in the private store (design part 13.3): when each recurring job last ran and how far into the ledger and the trust record it had read, so `hitld cadence due` counts only what is new. Written by `hitld cadence done`. Internal: never leaves the machine.

jobs.description: Per job: digest, report, baseline, eval, sweep, or review:<person>.

at.description: When the job was marked done.

through.description: The ID of the last ledger event the job had read; null when the ledger was empty.

files.description: How many events of each ledger file the job had read (HITLD-74): each file is append-only, so an event beyond these counts is new however it sorts in the ledger. A mark written before HITLD-74 has none.

trust_through.description: How many trust events the job had read.
